rationale: The focused protected-cargo panel is a pragmatic, implementable early-stage CMC gate that aligns with MISEV guidance and warrants experimental advancement. Before it can be relied on, the program must qualify capture reagents and spike-ins, demonstrate assay sensitivity and per-lot material sufficiency across ≥3 lots, and run follow-up potency or short-interval in vivo recoverability studies to exclude reproducible co-isolate or assay-artifact explanations.
